name: Kanoa Fortis
original_name: カノア・フォルティス
source:
[i]"Then kill me too. Say it, so my heart also stops... Say XXXX."[/i]

[i]Tribute to Order and Offense[/i]

A boy declared to be the strongest Grimnal.

His wind-manipulation Gift lets him transform even his own body into the wind. He's used his power to hunt down countless Grimnals, but he remains nothing but an object of fear to the populace. As a result, he's forced to wear restraints on his fingers when out in public.

Due to a warped personality that favors a sharp tongue and prickly words, he's very bad at conveying how he really feels. Though he often clashes with the heroine, calling her a "frump" and more, he appreciates the conviction she has to fight with the hand she's been dealt.

[spoiler]It is revealed that he entered another covenant with a different witch 6 years ago which led to him slowly aging backwards. In reality, he is 28 years old.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=kanoa]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
